description: This file defines middleware functions for security and request handling in an Express.js application. It includes CORS configuration with dynamic whitelist generation, Helmet middleware with relaxed Content Security Policy, and a rate limiter for dashboard endpoints.

methods.name: toOriginMaybe
methods.description: Normalizes a URL-like string to an origin (scheme://host[:port]) or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: corsMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware for handling CORS with a dynamically computed whitelist based on environment variables.

methods.name: helmetMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns a Helmet middleware with relaxed Content Security Policy and cross-origin resource policy.

methods.name: rateLimiter
methods.description: Creates and returns a rate limiting middleware with configurable window, max requests, and optional skipping for GET requests.
